$A_{0}=0^{5},\;B_{0}=1^{5}$ and write the meiosis with the stated left-from-first/right-from-second asymmetry as
${\cal R}_{k}(a,b)={\rm pref}_{k}(a)\,{\rm suff}_{>k}(b)$ on the + strand.
The reciprocal product is identified on the + strand, so $V_{k}=1^{k}0^{5-k}$ is not an independent + strand class.

With a bona fide recombination the cut has to be interior.  “Exactly one locus per generation for every gamete’’ is $1\le k\le4$, not the formal $0\le k\le5$ bookkeeping.  The telomeric $k=0,5$ formalisms are no recombination at all and regenerate $0^{5},1^{5}$.

$F_{1}\to F_{2}$ .
$F_{1}=A_{0}/B_{0}$ gives on the + strand
${\cal H}_{1}^{+}=\{{\cal R}_{k}(A_{0},B_{0}):1\le k\le4\}
      =\{0^{k}1^{5-k}:1\le k\le4\}
      =01111,00111,00011,00001$.
$|{\cal H}_{1}^{+}|=4$.
Every $F_{2}$ homologue is $0^{i}1^{5-i}$ with $1\le i\le4$, it starts $0$ and ends $1$ on the chosen strand and it is monotone $0\to1$.  In particular the parental $0^{5},1^{5}$ are never regenerated by an obligatory interior break.

$F_{2}\to F_{3}$ .
Put $a=0^{i_{a}}1^{5-i_{a}},\;b=0^{i_{b}}1^{5-i_{b}}\in{\cal H}_{1}^{+}$ and let the $F_{2}\to F_{3}$ cut be $k$, $1\le k\le4$.
$z_{a,b,k}={\rm pref}_{k}(a){\rm suff}_{>k}(b)$ satisfies
$z_{a,b,k,1}=0$, $z_{a,b,k,5}=1$ for every $a,b,k$ and
$z_{a,b,k}=0^{i_{a}}1^{k-i_{a}}0^{i_{b}-k}1^{5-i_{b}}$ for $i_{a}<k<i_{b}$,
$z_{a,b,k}=0^{t}1^{5-t}$ otherwise.

Hence every $F_{3}$ gamete seen on the fixed + strand is
$0x_{2}x_{3}x_{4}1$, $x_{i}\in\{0,1\}$, and every word of that form is realised, e.g.
$00101={\rm pref}_{2}(00111){\rm suff}_{>2}(00001)$.
The three interior sites $2,3,4$ are free and the first and last markers are fixed by the asymmetry.

${\cal H}_{3}^{+}=\{0x_{2}x_{3}x_{4}1:x_{i}\in\{0,1\}\}
 =00001,00011,00101,00111,01001,01011,01101,01111$.
$|{\cal H}_{3}^{+}|=2^{5-2}=2^{3}=8$ distinct + strand haplotypes can be carried as a single chromosome in an $F_{3}$ animal.  Four of them are the $F_{1}\to F_{2}$ monotones $01111,00111,00011,00001$ and
$01011,01001,01101,00101$ are the four genuine two-generation $0\!-\!1\!-\!0\!-\!1$ recombinants.

In ordered diploid notation this is $8^{2}=64$ maternal$\times$paternal pairs and up to phase
$N_{u}=8(8+1)/2=36$ unordered $F_{3}$ autosomal genotypes on the arbitrarily chosen strand, the familiar $2^{\,n-2}$ interior-obligatory crossover limit.  The mirror $1x_{2}x_{3}x_{4}0$ set is the same material on the opposite strand.

Remark.  With the textbook end-inclusive formal convention $0\le k\le5$ the $F_{1}$ pool is the $n+1=6$ monotone words $0^{i}1^{5-i}$ and a second fixed-orientation cut gives the $0^{*}1^{*}0^{*}1^{*}$ family
$|{\cal H}^{+}_{\rm ei}|=n+1+\binom{n+1}{3}=6+20=26$ + strand haplotypes, $26^{2}=676$ ordered and $26\cdot27/2=351$ unordered diploid $F_{3}$ autosomes.  This $26$-set collapses to the $2^{\,n-2}=8$ $0x_{2}x_{3}x_{4}1$ interior obligate set once the two telomeric formal cuts $k=0,5$ are removed and an obligatory interior crossover $1\le k\le4$ is required in every meiosis, which is the literal reading of “exactly one locus per generation for every gamete’’ with the stated sufficient strand asymmetry. ∎

11.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: The fixed orientation left-from-first/right-from-second rule with the reciprocal product identified on the + strand is the persistent model. Founders on + are A0=0^5, B0=1^5.

F1 → F2 with a bona fide obligatory interior cut 1≤k≤4. The + strand F1→F2 gamete pool is H1^+ = {0^k1^{5-k}:1≤k≤4}=01111,00111,00011,00001, |H1^+|=4. Every F2 chromosome on + is monotone 0^i1^{5-i}, 1≤i≤4, starts 0 ends 1, no 1→0 descent. The 1^k0^{5-k} class is the same material on the – strand and is not an independent + pool under the stated asymmetry; parental 0^5,1^5 are never regenerated by an obligatory interior cut.

F2 → F3 with a=0^{ia}1^{5-ia}, b=0^{ib}1^{5-ib}∈H1^+ and cut k∈{1..4}. R_k(a,b)=pref_k(a)suff_{>k}(b) satisfies R_k(a,b)_1=0, R_k(a,b)_5=1 for all a,b,k and

R_k(a,b)=0^{ia}1^{k-ia}0^{ib-k}1^{5-ib} for ia<k<ib

and monotone 0^t1^{5-t} otherwise. Hence every F3 gamete on the fixed + strand is 0x2x3x4 1 and the three interior sites 2,3,4 are free. The set is

H3^+ = {0x2x3x4 1 : xi∈{0,1}} = 00001,00011,00101,00111,01001,01011,01101,01111

|H3^+|=2^{5-2}=2^3=8 distinct + strand haplotypes. Four are the F1→F2 monotones 01111,00111,00011,00001 and 01011,01001,01101,00101 are the four genuine two-generation 0-1-0-1 recombinants. Ordered diploid 8^2=64, unordered diploid 8·9/2=36.

The conventional textbook end-inclusive formalisation 0≤k≤5 allows telomeric formal cuts k=0,5 which regenerate 0^5,1^5. Then H1^+,e has 6 monotone thresholds 0^i1^{5-i},0≤i≤5 and a second fixed orientation cut gives the 0*1*0*1* family 0^{a}1^{k-a}0^{b-k}1^{5-b},0≤a<k<b≤5. |H^+_{ei}|=n+1+ C(n+1,3)=6+20=26 + strand haplotypes with at most one 1→0 descent, 26^2=676 ordered and 26·27/2=351 unordered diploid F3 autosomes. The 26 set collapses to the 8 interior set above on removing the two telomeric formal cuts.

The 30-transition / 22-haplotype counts arise from treating U_k=0^k1^{5-k} and V_k=1^k0^{5-k} as independent + strand classes or allowing a prefix and a suffix to each contribute a 1→0 descent on the same orientation. With sufficient strand asymmetry the reciprocal product is identified, an F2 parent is monotone 0→1 on +, and a second fixed-orientation cut can create at most one new 1→0 descent on the chosen strand. The six words that inflate 26→30 are precisely those with two 1→0 descents on the same strand, e.g. 10101,01010.

Consensus in current round is the interior-obligatory reading: 8 distinct + strand haplotypes, 36 unordered diploid genotypes, the familiar 2^{n-2} interior limit. The 26/351 end-inclusive maximum is the conventional bookkeeping maximum that includes the formal telomeric cuts. Unresolved convention remains which reading the setter intends; the literal “exactly one locus per generation for every gamete’’ is the interior 1≤k≤4 → 8 haplotypes.
